name: Human Gate
description: Parks for a person to answer, the same shape as session-skeleton.bpmn's await_intent or craft-graph.bpmn's review_fragment. Answer it with `graph-agent resume <session> --answer <this activity>:key=value`; the form itself (its fields, defaults, labels) still needs a zeebe:userTaskForm written by hand or edited via a form editor -- this template only wires the activity up to reference one and publish what it answers with.

properties.label: Form id
properties.description: Id of a zeebe:userTaskForm defined elsewhere in this diagram (e.g. on the process's own extensionElements).

properties.label: Answer variable
properties.description: Process variable one of the form's own fields is published to -- add one of these per field the form asks for (session-skeleton.bpmn's await_intent maps three: intent, context, done). Edit the field name into the FEEL expression below via the properties panel's raw ioMapping view if this single mapping is not enough.
